summary.note: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) provides a complete inventory of all dependencies in SPDX format
alternatives: Dependency information can be inferred from package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml
GitHub dependency graph (when enabled) provides similar information
Use tools like syft or cyclonedx to generate local SBOM
